recommendations: Continue the parabola sequence from w14: vertex and axis (w15), sketching and equations from features (w16), intersections (w17), inequalities (w18) and models (w19), then cubics (w20).
w15 opens on w14's final frame (the light hammock h = 1/4 x^2 - x + 1.5 with "?" at its lowest point); its completed square answers that question: (2, 0.5), axis x = 2.
Teach the hyperbola (w21) before inverse variation (w23); w22 and w23 share ci52779ff4 and ci70194fe3 and need original n = 2 and 3 teaching, because the site teaches n = 1 only.
w24 owns ci7cdb9b15 (equation from a graph), which the site teaches in lesson23; w24's source list therefore includes lesson23 we-3.

Function properties run w26 (even and odd) before w28 (piecewise), because ci088a8d02 asks for symmetry tests on piecewise functions; w29 (continuity) follows w28; w30 and w31 (absolute value) close the strand and hand off to math-a11-c01.
Seven new site findings are listed in the w16, w17, w19, w20, w25, w27 and w28 packs (section 8) and are not yet in site-corrections-maths-a11.md.
covers: math-a11-w15 to math-a11-w31 (rest of the Working with functions strand)
